propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking diagnostic to verify that mapped project keys and legacy_default are visible to the bot outside a full reconcile pass

The bridge fsck command must gain an opt-in --live-visibility flag that performs a live mapped-project visibility check via the shared helper from ticket D, gated behind credential presence (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN)
When live credentials are absent and no probe is injected, the visibility step must gracefully emit a skipped advisory verdict without calling the probe and without altering the exit contract
The visibility audit must reuse the single shared helper check_mapped_project_visibility to avoid duplicate existence-check logic between the fsck layer and reconcile pass

The --live-visibility advisory output is written to stderr in both text and JSON modes and does not modify the stdout JSON schema or contract (unchanged required fields: unknown_event_types, binding_drift, store_integrity)
Core rebar doctor command must remain Jira-free with no new reconciler or agents imports reachable from _commands/doctor.py
